_comment: TEMPLATE - copy this file to profiles.json and fill in your values. Find your monitor EDIDs by running Show-DisplayState.ps1 (each active display shows its EDID as mfr:prod, hex). Positions are virtual-desktop pixels; the monitor at [0,0] becomes the primary. Negative y = above, negative x = left.

work.description: Example: monitor-b is the main display; monitor-a is turned off.

personal.description: Example: monitor-a is the main display at (0,0); monitor-b is extended to its right.
